description: 白墨 Harness — Pi 内核 + Electron 壳的桌面 Agent 产品
name: baimo-harness

scripts.build: npm run build -w @baimo-harness/core && npm run build -w @baimo-harness/agent-host && npm run build -w @baimo-harness/ui && npm run build -w @baimo-harness/desktop
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test "packages/rpc/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/core/test/*.test.mjs" "apps/agent-host/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/ui/test/*.test.mjs" && node apps/desktop/scripts/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:regression: npm run build && node --test "packages/rpc/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/core/test/*.test.mjs" "apps/agent-host/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/ui/test/*.test.mjs" "tests/regression/*.test.mjs" && node apps/desktop/scripts/run-e2e.mjs
